paragraphs: Hello! My name is João Pedro Tomaz dos Santos, and I’m deeply passionate about computing and software engineering. My programming journey began in late 2020 as a self-taught developer, exploring the world of code out of pure curiosity. Today, I am proud to be pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science at the prestigious Universidade Federal de São Carlos (UFSCar).

Combining my hands-on, self-taught experience with the strong theoretical foundation from my university studies, I've developed a highly versatile skill set. I started with fundamental programming logic and quickly expanded into building full-stack web applications using React and Node.js, as well as engineering low-level IoT projects with C++ and Arduino.

Beyond writing code, I have a solid background in systems administration. I am well-versed in navigating Linux environments and configuring web servers like Apache and Nginx. This end-to-end understanding—from hardware sensors and server infrastructure to modern web interfaces—allows me to architect and deliver complete, robust solutions.

I believe that technology should be impactful and accessible. Whether I'm tackling a low-level system challenge or designing a seamless user experience, my ultimate goal is to build high-quality software that solves real-world problems.
